data.title: Athena robot fluidly throws, catches and hits balls in baseball demo
data.description: RAI's AthenaZero robot has demonstrated its ability to throw, catch, and hit balls using coordinated movements and a low-inertia design.
data.author: Kaif Shaikh
data.keywords: Artificial intelligence, AthenaZero, Automation, humanoid robotics, robot arms, robotic manipulation, Robotics, Robotics and AI Institute
